ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) surface area with high-intensity (white) pixels accounting for approximately 5-8% of the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a contiguous dark field; high-contrast light grey mottling is localized around the median notch and extends in thin streaks toward the trailing edge. High-intensity white clusters are located at the lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration with numerous peaks and valleys; deeper indentations (notches) are present on the distal halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the superior edges of both lobes tapering to sharp, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast white pixel clusters (barnacle colonizations) on the lateral tips of both lobes; the left tip cluster is larger and more structurally complex.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the central-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle clusters on distal tips and prominent white linear rake marks on the left ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity specular highlights and pixel noise caused by water droplets and spray adhering to the fluke surface.
